hypothesis: The single-topic fast route misses on every topic switch, so an 8-topic round-robin workload would pay the slow path (fast/cluster/nodes locks, Cluster::leader address-String clone, full remember_fast rebuild) per record; a bounded versioned multi-topic cache would remove it.
limits: The frozen mixed-topics cell (cells.rs generate(): 8 sequential 2,500-record topic chunks; drive_pipelined sends in order, single task) never alternates topics per record: 8 chunk-boundary misses + ~28 warmup QueueFull misses per 20,000 records, 19,964 fast hits. The card's mechanism addresses a pattern the named cell does not exhibit.
Alloc route equally unreachable: 36 slow-path records x ~3 allocs each / 20,000 = ~0.005 allocs/record = ~0.5% of the 1.12 cell allocs (deterministic bar: 5%).

A future interleaved-topics cell (per-record alternation) could resurrect this card: at 20k misses the same ~1.6us/miss slow path would be ~32ns/record (~6% of cell). Redefining the frozen KL09-09/10 cell to suit the card was out of scope; cells stay comparable.
Cluster::leader's address-String clone likewise fires only on the slow path (~36 calls/cell); unmeasured separately because the whole slow path is already 6x under bar.
